citation.description: Ruling recorded in ticket description ('RULED: attest them.') and FIXED-738A-B comment ('Ruling: update the close gate to provide attestation for duplicates with a live link. Done.'). Implementation in close_disposition.py and close_precheck.py enacts the ruling.

criteria.criterion: The operator rules on whether disposition-closed children resolve certification through their replacement link, or must remain uncertified by design — RULED: attest them.

`child_closure_findings` and the close gate share ONE definition of 'disposition with a live replacement': `close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES` is asserted equal to `close_precheck._NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES` — verified by `pytest tests/unit/test_close_disposition_attestation_738a.py`
A disposition close MINTS a `completion-verifier` attestation, and its manifest does NOT claim a completion PASS that never happened (it reads `DISPOSITION <class>` + the replacement id)
The negative case still holds: NO live replacement link ⇒ no attestation, so the close keeps normal verification and `--class duplicate` cannot become a bypass
`--force-close` remains UNSIGNED — its guard runs before the disposition branch, mutation-checked by reverting the guard's position and observing the test fail
The wiring is exercised through the REAL `_completion_precheck`, not only the module in isolation (the call site moved during bug 74a3's split; a piece-only suite stayed green through the move)

citation.description: FIXED-738A-B comment records: 'verify_signature(0059, kind="completion-verifier") -> certified' and 'child_closure_findings(e369) -> uncertified 2 -> 1 (only b586 remains)'. The code path enabling this is fully implemented: close_disposition.verdict() mints the attestation, _completion_precheck calls it at close_precheck.py:197-203, and child_closure_findings at completion.py:172 finds the completion-verifier attestation and counts it as certified.

criteria.criterion: End-to-end: `verify_signature(0059, kind="completion-verifier")` returns `certified` and epic e369's uncertified descendant count drops from 2 to 1
